title: CR: builder 4 cross-review and two source-backed corrections
public_pr_body:
Reviews all 34 changed files in #290–#297 at the full heads recorded in tests/CR-BUILDER-4-CROSS-REVIEW.md, plus #314 at bbf21d67ca87c5d161022d149f2ef0ea5ec62ad7 and all twelve sign-off sheets #301–#313 (excluding CU #305). Each sheet head and source check is recorded; no signature or operator result inferred.

Two corrections on this independent branch: C10 cites lib/accounting/cloud-adapters.ts; AI cap wording no longer treats used+reserved as a reliable off switch because settlement can release capacity. Existing company AI off control is named instead. No maths, permissions or send behaviour changed.

#314's CN/CU corrections are valid: block external AI on restored real data until separate approval; Sage/QuickBooks current adapters support balance checks, not invoice exports; require actual MFA challenge/refusal; distinguish visible AI-off smoke from exhaustive API proof. Retain those corrected CN/CU versions in final integration. No additional source mistake found in the twelve unsigned sheets. Their completion remains an operator task.

Existing affected cap suites: 11 passed, zero failures/skips. Changed component lint passes. CV records separate exact tested snapshots; later report extension here is documentation only. Original builder-4 branches, handovers and docs/signoff/ untouched. No production SQL, main merge, Ready label or broad audit.

Exact head: 8d161eca667cf3a64b4a9aaffb2df6ddba9d673d. Scoped source review, not independent release approval.

- [x] Original eight PRs, #314 and twelve sign-off sheets reviewed; changes listed
- [ ] Independent review and actual runtime/operator proofs

Follow-through committed: the exact reviewed #314 CN and CU content now also lives in our existing drafts #286 (bfaa31b84ebb04cec74c386787806320c3dee44e) and #305 (78dc5b7033592f20640b15e61b198c7fcf17930e). These are the additional document corrections listed in the report; retain them when combining CV's earlier frozen snapshot. Preceding CR CI 41837435184: web success, integration skipped, ci-gate failure. Current run 41839489160 pending at this snapshot; no full integration pass claimed.
